Peek beta

The beta of Peek for Android, the universal parcel tracker, built without Google's libraries and signed with Peek's own key. If you installed Peek 1.1.18 or earlier from GitHub or the Peek beta F-Droid repository, or Peek from Google Play, uninstall it first: the copies here are signed with a different key. Source code: https://github.com/plhery/peek-delivery-tracker

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plhery/peek-delivery-tracker/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
2B A2 68 AF 2C 76 EF B2 C2 62 DA 7C A8 49 92 84 B7 CC 7D 0F 76 DC BE 47 A8 AB A5 70 30 67 F1 A7
